title: Trips by property and by client
description: Every route is tied to the work address it belongs to, and the totals are available separately.

blocks.text: One person’s trips can have different clients and different purposes. A single mileage total hides which job it belongs to.

quote.text: I’ve used Hurdlr for over 5 years now. Seems less complicated and it is less expensive than quickbooks. For my business as a realtor, it has been very effective at helping me track income, expenses, and mileage.

blocks.text: Suggest the tag of a familiar property and let the person confirm it after the trip. Build reports by property, by client and by period.
A matching address does not always mean the same purpose. An automatic suggestion has to be told apart from a classification the user has confirmed.
